blacklistabilityReview.evidence: POSTURE CHANGE on 2026-07-22: direct holder control is Yes because the material TON USDe jetton can be locked by its administrator. Ethereum USDe exposes owner-set minter authority and ordinary ERC-20 transfers but no holder freeze or blacklist, and a finalized Solana read at slot 434568679 returned freezeAuthority=null. On TON, verified jetton-minter.fc code for EQAIb6KmdfdDR7CN1GBqVJuP25iCnLKCvBlJ07Evuu2dzP5f gives the administrator an upgrade path and an admin-only call_to operation that can send set_status to any derived jetton wallet; the verified source explicitly describes this path as able to lock, unlock, or redeem funds. The 2026-07-22 state was pinned to master code hash a9bfedc76d60b332e8019e405505aadf4d7f870b8d3bae7abcfeb868681e6b2a and last transaction LT 91438387000020 / hash bf7da7303ee7eb1ac66741c08f6ba5146fc6fdde56206118f6801b30673f2727, with administrator EQCrj-smMj6JQCAvb-BPwlMa71IAA7pK3KNaFcVOdeYC6qS7. This TON holder-control path makes the asset-level direct posture true even though the reviewed Ethereum and Solana deployments lack an equivalent active freeze authority.

oracleRisk.summary: Ethena's offchain hedging system prices mint and redeem requests from exchange market data and validates internal pricing with Pyth and RedStone, but USDe has no permissionless CDP liquidation oracle.

branchApplicability.rationale: USDe is minted and redeemed through signed orders accepted by Ethena's offchain pricing and hedging services, while backing assets are paired with centrally managed derivatives hedges. It does not expose user CDP markets with per-collateral onchain liquidation thresholds, liquidation auctions, backstops, or shutdown branches, so the V9 collateral-liquidation branch families do not apply.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: USDe uses or is linked to LayerZero/OFT-style cross-chain token infrastructure. Because OFT/adapter routes depend on external messaging, endpoint configuration, and lock/mint or burn/mint token contracts outside issuer-native redemption alone, Pharos scores the reviewed route as external lock/mint.

Re-verified from Tempo mainnet RPC at block 31232268 on 2026-07-22: 0x5d3a1ff2b6bab83b63cd9ad0787074081a52ef34 is a minimal EIP-1967 proxy with implementation 0xbd78bd7f1fd926b893f2f502c41deea7ea63ad8a and a zero admin slot. endpoint() returns Tempo's published LayerZero V2 endpoint 0x20bb7c2e2f4e5ca2b4c57060d1ae2615245dcc9c, but name(), symbol(), decimals(), totalSupply(), and owner() all revert. The implementation bytecode also lacks the standard ERC-20 metadata selectors. The address therefore cannot be honestly identified as a USDe token deployment or attributed to a token controller, so the route remains unresolved.
